governance_standard: ARX Closure Model v2 — Reconciled Interpretation/Action Separation

BETA-01.rationale: Normative swing trade in Concept B (True Negative). Participant inspected quarantined proof drawer, recognized intraday limitation, adhered to $395 structural stop, and approved canonical 28 shares without error.

BETA-02.rationale: Participant treated discovery radar watchlist eligibility ('SCREEN_ONLY: DISCOVERY_RADAR') as an immediate execution buy signal ('eligible on radar means system found a trade! Buying 100 shares right now'). Violates CM-09 (WATCH state interpreted as immediate BUY; INTERPRETATION_INCORRECT) and SM-05 (Screening conflated with execution trigger; ACTION_INAPPROPRIATE).

BETA-03.rationale: Participant treated an uncalibrated 88/100 heuristic ranking score as an empirical 88% win probability ('An 88% win probability is practically guaranteed'; SM-04, INTERPRETATION_INCORRECT) and doubled the risk budget to $2,000 (SM-02, ACTION_INAPPROPRIATE).

BETA-04.rationale: Participant set order limit buy price to Take Profit 1 ($118.00) instead of current market/pivot level ($98.40) stating '$118 is where I enter to capture momentum'. Violates CM-03 (Target interpreted as entry price; INTERPRETATION_INCORRECT, ACTION_INAPPROPRIATE).

BETA-05.rationale: Normative fundamental review under Concept C (True Negative). Participant engaged with bear dissent, noted UNAVAILABLE entry pivot in timing console, and correctly deferred execution pending pivot confirmation (INTERPRETATION_CORRECT, ACTION_APPROPRIATE).

BETA-06.rationale: Adversarial pipeline test handled correctly (True Negative). Participant spotted degraded pipeline telemetry banner and refused to stage trade, flagging setup for pipeline recovery (INTERPRETATION_CORRECT, ACTION_APPROPRIATE).

BETA-07.rationale: Participant placed a stop-loss at $435.00 on a $420.00 long entry ('above current spot where resistance was'). Violates CM-08 (Stop loss and entry direction inverted; INTERPRETATION_INCORRECT, ACTION_INAPPROPRIATE).

BETA-08.rationale: Participant explicitly read and acknowledged the NOT_ACTIONABLE: EXTENDED badge ('The verdict badge says NOT_ACTIONABLE: EXTENDED... I am going to buy anyway despite the NOT_ACTIONABLE status'). The participant accurately understood platform semantics (INTERPRETATION_CORRECT); CM-02 (NOT_ACTIONABLE interpreted as actionable) does NOT apply because participant never believed setup was approved. However, participant committed an unauthorized policy override (ACTION_INAPPROPRIATE).

BETA-09.rationale: Normative swing trade in Concept A (True Negative). Participant sized 1,492 shares without error.
